intent: Grouped page block with optional heading, description, and actions. Collapsible, chevron before the title.
useWhen: Separating metrics, tables, or form groups on a page
Under PageHeader to structure dashboard or settings content
doNotUseWhen: Form legends and grouped fields — use FieldSet
Modal body layout — keep content minimal inside Modal

size.note: Controls gap under the heading and between stacked sections via space-section tokens

actions.note: kit Buttons only. One primary per view.

collapsible.note: When title is set, a chevron sits before the title and toggles the body. False keeps the body always open.

requirements: Collapse control is a button inside the h2, aria-expanded and aria-controls

doNot: Do not invent a local Section or SectionHeader
Do not frame Section — that is Card
Do not use Section as the page title — that is PageHeader
Do not embed one-off metric flex rows — use Scoreboard
Do not compose Accordion or Collapsible for page sections — Section owns collapse
snippet: <Section title="Recent activity" description="Last 30 days" actions={<Button variant="secondary" size="sm">View all</Button>}><Table ... /></Section>
